Knowledge recorded by Shinnecock elders in 2014

Horseshoe crabs

The catalogue records horseshoe crabs along Shinnecock shores and draws attention to the spring season. Elders remembered a striking molting event in June 2012.1

Places named in the catalogue

Long Island Sound; Atlantic Ocean; Shinnecock Bay; Mecox Bay; Montauk Bay; Peconic Bay; Napeague Bay.1

Page references

The Shinnecock Environmental Department compiled this catalogue from elders’ memories and community resource knowledge in 2014. Food and medicine appear here as historical knowledge; safe identification and treatment require current guidance.

Shinnecock Environmental Department, Natural Resources Identified by Shinnecock Elders, April 4, 2014, PDF p. 4. Page numbers count the cover as PDF page 1.
